item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Closed-loop hydroponic cultivation, with high water and fertilizer use efficiency, for the production of vegetables (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The research activity covered by this contract will focus on the development and validation of closed-loop hydroponic cultivation protocols for vegetable production, characterized by high water and fertilizer use efficiency. The activities will include: i) the use of sensors and decision-making models to optimize the management of the nutrient solution and the microclimate; ii) the analysis of agronomic and nutritional factors that influence nickel accumulation in the edible parts of the plants; and iii) the evaluation of agronomic and biological strategies aimed at reducing—or even entirely eliminating—the use of synthetic plant protection products. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Characterization of the transmission dynamics of Xylella fastidiosa by insect vectors in vineyards and semi-natural environments (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Lussemburgo
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

*Xylella fastidiosa* subsp. *fastidiosa* Sequence Type 1 (Xff-ST1) represents a new threat to European viticulture, particularly in light of its detection in table grape vineyards in Apulia. The project aims to understand the epidemiology of *Xylella fastidiosa* in table grape vineyards and to investigate the role of spontaneous vegetation and non-cultivated environments in supporting insect vector populations and acting as sources or recipients of the bacterium. The results will improve the understanding of vector-pathogen-host interactions, identify key epidemiological risk factors, and provide data useful for risk assessment and the development of effective disease management strategies.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Exploring Bioactivity of Natural Compounds: From Encapsulation Strategies to Drug Discovery for Biomedical Targets (BRIDGE) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-24 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-07 Scienze e tecnologie alimentari

The project aims to investigate natural compounds derived from grape and apple by-products as potential inhibitors of protein aggregation associated with Huntington's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. As part of a broader multi-institutional research project, the researcher's work at UNIBZ will focus on optimizing sustainable extraction and purification methods to recover bioactive molecules—specifically polyphenols—from grape pomace and apple peels. Particular attention will be paid to ultrasound-assisted extraction, microwave-assisted extraction, and supercritical CO2 extraction.
